name: A-796260
summary: A-796,260 is a drug developed by Abbott Laboratories that acts as a potent and selective cannabinoid CB2 receptor agonist.6 nM vs 945 nM at CB1. It has potent analgesic and anti-inflammatory actions in animal models, being especially effective in models of neuropathic pain, but without producing cannabis-like behavioral effects.

pharmacology.text: A-796,260 is a drug developed by Abbott Laboratories that acts as a potent and selective cannabinoid CB2 receptor agonist.

uses.text: A-796,260 is a drug developed by Abbott Laboratories that acts as a potent and selective cannabinoid CB2 receptor agonist.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is a laboratory research compound and has not been tested in people, so its effects and risks are unknown.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它是實驗室研究用化合物，未曾在人體測試，因此作用與風險都不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它是实验室研究用化合物，未曾在人体测试，因此作用与风险都不明。

fact.en: It picks out the CB2 cannabinoid receptor, which sits mainly on immune cells, so in animals it relieves pain without the effects on the mind that come from acting on CB1.
fact.zh: 它能挑選出主要分布在免疫細胞上的CB2大麻素受體，因此在動物身上能止痛，而不會產生作用於CB1所帶來的精神影響。
fact.zhHans: 它能挑选出主要分布在免疫细胞上的CB2大麻素受体，因此在动物身上能止痛，而不会产生作用于CB1所带来的精神影响。
